Priya Nair: Quick question — onboarding an external engineer to help debug the redaction pipeline in project redaction-prod. They only need to view logs + tail for a few days. What's the least-privilege role we should grant? @Jordan (security)

Jordan (security): For viewing logs only, grant roles/logging.viewer at the project scope. Avoid Owner/Editor. If they need to create/export sinks, also add roles/logging.configWriter or give storage permissions on the export bucket. Prefer giving a service account or short-lived access rather than a permanent user binding. :thumbsup:

Sam Ortiz: They'll sign in via SSO. Any recommended duration for ephemeral access?

Jordan (security): Use our JIT flow — 24h by default via people-ops provisioning. If they need >24h, security review + request to security@redwood with justification and approver.

Priya Nair: Do we need any extra role for gcloud logging tail/read? Like logs.viewer is fine?

Jordan (security): Yes logging.viewer lets you list/read log entries and use gcloud logging read/tail. For k8s pod logs, they need cluster-level k8s RBAC (eng-sre handle). If using the API, ensure they don't get service account token access unless necessary.

Maggie Chen: Reminder — the pipeline logs currently contain PII in request payloads. Should we redact before giving access?

Jordan (security): Strong yes. If logs contain PII, create a redacted export or filtered view and grant access to that. If immediate debugging requires raw fields, escalate to privacy and do a scoped temporary access with monitoring. Also consider granting 'logs.viewer' on a subset of log names rather than whole project where possible.

Priya Nair: OK — I'll open the access request: https://redwood.internal/requests/RED-4123 and attach screenshots of the fields we need. Planning to bind to a service account: sa-redact-external@redaction-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com

Priya Nair: gcloud command we'll run if approved:
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redaction-prod \n  --member='serviceAccount:sa-redact-external@redaction-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \n  --role='roles/logging.viewer'
```

infra-bot: Access request RED-4123 created and routed to security for review.

access-bot: Reminder — include justification + exact log names to scope the role. :eyes:

Priya Nair: Thanks everyone — I'll include the redaction plan and ping again once security approves. :pray:
